method: Read public provider documentation/catalogue and repository metadata; retain retrieval status, URL and hashes. Reuse terminal source receipts without reopening their payloads or outcomes. Apply the optionsDX census authority unchanged. Validate forward collector only through its source-health receipt.
allowed_new_payload_rule: Any new potentially admissible USD 0 pre-2025 BBO corpus requires a separate immutable source-only acquisition authority before payload opening. No such new corpus has been identified by current metadata research.
forward_health_exception: Existing FORWARD_BBO_COLLECTOR_AUTHORITY_V0.1 source-only current capture; inspect counts/hash/health receipt only, never strategy outcomes.
